AudioHardwareIOProcStreamUsage.doc: This structure describes which streams a given AudioDeviceIOProc will use. It is used in conjunction with kAudioDevicePropertyIOProcStreamUsage.

AudioObjectPropertyAddress.doc: An AudioObjectPropertyAddress collects the three parts that identify a specific property together in a struct for easy transmission.

AudioStreamRangedDescription.doc: This structure allows a specific sample rate range to be associated with an AudioStreamBasicDescription that specifies its sample rate as kAudioStreamAnyRate.
